reels.caption:
You & Me, Lake Como?⛲️🌿

Towns to Visit🗺
The lake's most iconic scenery is found in the "Golden Triangle" at its centre✨

Bellagio: Often called the "Pearl of Lake Como," this town is famous for its steep, cobblestone streets and luxury boutiques🌳

Varenna: A romantic fishing village with colourful houses and the most accessible train station for arrivals from Milan.

Menaggio: A laid-back town with a lovely waterfront promenade, popular for its central ferry connections.

Como: The largest city, located at the southwestern tip, offering significant history, high-end shopping, and a funicular to the hilltop village of Brunate.

Top Things to Do🛥️
Explore Historic Villas: Visit Villa del Balbianello (featured in Star Wars and James Bond) or Villa Carlotta for its 14 acres of botanical gardens.
Hop-on Hop-off Ferry: The best way to see the lake is from the water. Use the public Navigazione Laghi ferry system to travel between towns.
Villa Monastero garden: A former monastery with a stunning botanical garden stretching along the eastern shoreline.

Planning Tips💡
Best Time to Visit: April to June and September to early October offer the best balance of pleasant weather and lush gardens without the intense July/August crowds.
Getting Around: Avoid bringing a car; parking is scarce and expensive. Stick to ferries for inter-town travel and trains for reaching Varenna or Como from Milan.
Booking: Popular attractions like Villa del Balbianello require booking tickets online well in advance🎫

reels.caption:
Steal my 6-Day Amalfi Coast Itinerary🇮🇹 Save for your upcoming trip!

I stayed at @hotelmiramalfi and loved everything about it! The location, rooms, pool, elevated service 🔥

Day 1 – Positano
☕️ Breakfast at Angelo Caffé
📸 Walk along Via Cristoforo Colombo for the best view
🪴 Browse Ceramic Shops
⛱️ Spend the afternoon at Positano or Furore beach or one of these beach clubs:• Arienzo Beach Club (reachable by boat)• Pupetto Beach Club or La Scogliera
🚤 Take a boat tour along the coast with @bluestarpositano
🍽️ Lunch at Terrazza Celè or Bruno's
🚗 Vintage car tour with @positanoclassic
🍸Sunset drinks at Francos

Day 2 - Procida
📸 Start at Panoramica sulla Corricella
🚶🏻‍♀️Stroll through Marina Corricella's narrow colorful streets
🌆 Another great view from Belvedere Corricella
🍽️ Lunch at Chiaro di Luna by the water
🏰 Visit Palazzo d'Avalos, the abandoned cliffside prison

Day 3 – Amalfi & Atrani
⛪️ Visit the Duomo di Amalfi and walk the streets
🍧 Try lemon sorbet
🏖️ Relax at Marina Grande Beach or visit Fiordo di Furore
🚶🏼 Walk to Atrani (about 10 mins)🍽️ Lunch at Le Arcate in Atrani
🌸 Wander Atrani's streets and small square
🍴Sunset dinner at Donna Emma @hotelmiramalfi

Day 4 – Capri
⛴️ Ferry to Capri
🚤 Take a boat tour around the island (Blue Grotto, Faraglioni, Marina Piccola)
⛱️ Book a lounger at La Fontelina Beach Club
🌳 Walk through Giardini di Augusto
📍 Photo stop at Belvedere Tragara
🥾 Optional hike to the Natural Arch or visit Villa Lysis
🚠 Chairlift to Monte Solaro for a panoramic view
🍽️ Lunch at Lo Scoglio delle Sirene (Marina Piccola)

Day 5 – Sorrento
🚶🏼 Walk around Piazza Tasso and browse Corso Italia
🍋 Lunch at O'Parrucchiano (dine under lemon trees)
🌊 Head to Marina Grande for a seaside walk or beach time
🍸 Drinks at Grand Hotel Excelsior Vittoria
🌇 Sunset at Villa Comunale

Day 6 – Ravello
🏛️ Visit Villa Cimbrone
🌿 Stroll through Villa Rufolo
⛪️ Stop by Duomo di Ravello
🍽️ Lunch at Ristorante Belvedere or Trattoria Da Lorenzo
🛍️ Explore the small piazza

Yaklaşık 5 aydır Arabistan'dayım ve burada gerçekten çok güzel evler görüyorum. Genellikle yüksek duvarlar, büyük kapılar ve iç avlularla tasarlanıyor. Bunun en önemli sebebi mahremiyeti korumak ve sıcak iklime uyum sağlamak. Bu mimari hem geleneksel Arap kültürünü yansıtıyor hem de sıcak havada daha serin bir yaşam alanı oluşturuyor.

Siz böyle bir evde yaşamak ister miydiniz? 😊

I've been in Saudi Arabia for about 5 months and I see many beautiful houses here. They are usually designed with high walls, large doors and inner courtyards. The main reason is to protect privacy and adapt to the hot climate. This architectural style reflects traditional Arab culture and helps create cooler living spaces.

Would you like to live in a house like this? 😊

أنا في السعودية منذ حوالي خمسة أشهر، وخلال هذه الفترة أرى الكثير من البيوت الجميلة هنا. غالبًا ما تُصمَّم هذه البيوت بجدران عالية وأبواب كبيرة وفناء داخلي. والسبب الرئيسي هو الحفاظ على الخصوصية والتكيّف مع المناخ الحار. كما يعكس هذا التصميم الطابع المعماري العربي التقليدي ويوفّر بيئة أكثر برودة للعيش.

هل تحب أن تعيش في بيت مثل هذا؟ 😊
